name: Rocket Fuel - (5g) Baller Bucket - Jealousy
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Rocket Fuel Jealousy Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Jealousy is an award-winning hybrid born from crossing Gelato 41 with Sherbert Bx1, and the flavor is as refined as the reputation. Expect a rich, layered profile: sweet creamy dessert notes up front with a sharp, gassy edge and a smooth, subtly fruity finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a potent, balanced experience that lifts the mood while easing the body into a mellow calm.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Jealousy flavor — sweet cream and dessert notes with a sharp, gassy edge
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Jealousy is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
